capabilities: Scans the vault for events written as Markdown checklist items with attribute lines
Displays events in calendar, day-list, hourly timeline, and all-tasks dashboard views embedded via code blocks
Fires per-event alarm modals with sound and vibration at a set time
Projects recurring events (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly) up to a configurable horizon
Reschedules events by dragging on the calendar and writes changes back to the Markdown file
extras: Manual installation is required until it is listed in the Obsidian community plugin registry; the README also documents limits such as projected recurring events being read-only.
motivation: The author wants everything to live in plain Markdown notes with no external database, sync account, or proprietary format, and alarms that work without OS notification permissions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in event dashboard or reminder system, so scheduling from notes usually means relying on external calendar apps.

relations.evidence: Install CEvent Planner Extra plugin also to Create Event Visually.

summary: Markdown-based event planner that scans the vault for checklist-style events and shows them in calendar, list, and time-view dashboards with alarms and recurring events.
